title: cli: os validate --target accepts only a profile file — add the URL form once an environment publishes its restriction profile at a defined route (cloud#3713)
body:
domain:server#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2dLQEXWGsE2SZ3Qn5F

Filing gate: ③ follow-up of #31156 item 2 (PR #31237, dev report 6711857510, open question 2): the URL form of `--target` was deliberately not built because no route exists to fetch from. ⛔ Not a claim. Blocked on objectstack-ai/cloud#3713 (card 3/4) naming the endpoint. Triage sets the grade and the lane.
Reader: the seat that owns `packages/cli` (`src/utils/restriction-profile.ts` `loadRestrictionProfile`, `src/commands/validate.ts` step 0).
Dedupe (open AND closed): `restriction profile`, `RestrictionProfile` → only #31155 / #31156.
reach: authors validating against a hosted environment; today they save the profile as a JSON file first.
class: c · type: Feature

## 维护者速读

`os validate --target` 现在只接受本地文件，传 URL 会被拒绝，因为目标环境还没有定义发布限制配置的地址。等 cloud#3713 定下地址后，再让它直接从环境读取。

## What is missing

- `loadRestrictionProfile` refuses any `scheme://` target, naming the file form as the remedy. No route for a published profile exists in this repo (spec route ledger, `packages/spec/src/api`).

## Expected

- Once cloud#3713 names the route (and its auth), `--target <environment URL>` fetches the profile from that route and parses it with `RestrictionProfileSchema` exactly as the file form does; an unreachable or invalid response is refused, never treated as "no restriction".
- Pins: URL fetch parses and judges like the file; a 404 / non-JSON / schema-invalid response is refused naming the URL; the file form unchanged (CONTROL).
- No guessed route before cloud#3713 defines it.
